title: Mara and the Debt
author: Edmund Underhill
blurb: Ivo Fairweather, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
